documents.subject: Annual review
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Annual review with Gleitring-Systeme Kaltenbrunn AG. Their sales director said there is no room on price this year: head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. He was open on payment terms and call-off flexibility.

documents.text: Annual review with Gleitring-Systeme Kaltenbrunn AG. Their key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

quote_remarks.remarks: Prices as per current list; discounts not possible this year (head-office directive).

persona.summary: Swiss seal group (900 staff, EUR 247 M), sole source of our ATEX drinking-water cartridge seal; we are 0.17 % of its turnover. Head office froze all price reductions until December 2027 and quotes list price only; pricing committee above 2 %. Excellent quality (0 ppm, OTD 96-100 %). Price is 16.6 % over the should-cost of its plant. Open on payment terms and call-off flexibility: take value there, open moderate.
persona.notes: Wants price stability and to keep a frozen list; never got an increase from us (asked +1.3-3.3 %, settled 0). Contradiction: March note says committee approves changes above 2 %, August note and quote say no reductions at all. Contract auto-extended to 2027 (180-day notice passed). Hard to replace: drinking-water approvals.

evidence.quote: head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027.
Prices as per current list; discounts not possible this year (head-office directive).
price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

levers: longer payment terms (it is open on them)
arguments: should-cost of its plant: EUR 273.72 vs 319.11 (16.6 % above cost)
notice-period breach: 180-day notice for 2027 changes has passed
avoid: price asks above 2 % that go to its committee
changing terms after its final offer
threatening to resource: no approved second source
tactics: Open moderately; aim for a price step within 2 % to stay below its committee threshold.
Cite the should-cost of its plant once as the main price argument.
If price will not move, take value in longer payment terms (30 to 60 days) and call-off flexibility.
Reject any increase: the 180-day notice before year end has passed.
Accept a reasonable final offer; it is sole source with no approved alternative.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; it has never moved on price either way, so expect little or no price movement and concessions on payment and call-off terms.
